legalResultStates.label: PERMITTED
legalResultStates.meaning: The reviewed rule permits the conduct within the established scope.

legalResultStates.label: RESTRICTED
legalResultStates.meaning: The reviewed rule permits the conduct only subject to conditions or limits.

legalResultStates.label: PROHIBITED
legalResultStates.meaning: The reviewed rule prohibits the conduct within the established scope.

legalResultStates.label: DISPUTED
legalResultStates.meaning: Competing legal positions remain materially unresolved.

legalResultStates.label: UNRESOLVED
legalResultStates.meaning: The record is insufficient for a reviewed legal result.

applicabilityAxes.label: Temporal
applicabilityAxes.question: Was the instrument or rule in force at the relevant time?

applicabilityAxes.label: Territorial
applicabilityAxes.question: Did the rule extend to the relevant place, conduct, forum, or effects?

applicabilityAxes.label: Personal
applicabilityAxes.question: Was the actor, entity, State, organization, vessel, or protected class within scope?

applicabilityAxes.label: Subject-matter
applicabilityAxes.question: Did the rule govern the type of conduct, object, offense, right, or obligation at issue?

reviewPipeline.label: SOURCE
reviewPipeline.description: Acquire official or attributable legal text with provenance.

reviewPipeline.label: AUTHORITY
reviewPipeline.description: Establish hierarchy, status, jurisdiction, and binding or persuasive weight.

reviewPipeline.label: APPLICABILITY
reviewPipeline.description: Evaluate temporal, territorial, personal, and subject-matter scope.

reviewPipeline.label: COMPETING CLAIMS
reviewPipeline.description: Preserve exceptions, defenses, conflicts, interpretations, and uncertainty.

reviewPipeline.label: HUMAN REVIEW
reviewPipeline.description: Approve an explainable result without bypassing evidence or provenance.

guardrails: legal text presence does not establish applicability
authority does not imply universal scope
source discovery does not produce an automatic verdict
observability is operational metadata, not legal evidence
reviewed legal analysis remains distinct from Mizan and evidence reconstruction
